# Standardise tables

## Reference points

terr_refpoints (git2rdata object): defines the reference point for the terrestrial population units and grts-ranking for this refpoint

+ point_code: the id of the reference point
+ is_centroid: is the reference point located in the center of a grts-master grid cell
+ grts_ranking
+ x: x-coordinate (crs = 31370)
+ y: y-coordinate (crs = 31370)

```{r}
mhq_terr_refpoints_new <- refpoints_assessed_all %>%
    anti_join(mhq_terr_refpoints, by = "point_code") %>%
    select(point_code, is_centroid, grts_ranking, x, y)

check_unique <- mhq_terr_refpoints_new %>%
    group_by(point_code) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup()

mhq_terr_refpoints_update <- mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
    bind_rows(mhq_terr_refpoints_new)
```

We add the newly created reference points to version 'rapportage2025' of `mhq_terr_refpoints`

We check the values for `grts_ranking` and `is_centroid`.
`is_centroid` = TRUE when it the reference point is within 1 m of the grid center.

```{r}

distance_from_centroidgrid <- function(min_x, min_y, measured_x, measured_y, resolution = 32) {
    
    difference_x <- (measured_x - min_x) %% resolution
    shortest_distance_x <- min(difference_x, resolution - difference_x)
    difference_y <- (measured_y - min_y) %% resolution
    shortest_distance_y <- min(difference_y, resolution - difference_y)
    distance_from_grid <- sqrt( shortest_distance_x ^ 2 + shortest_distance_y ^ 2)
    
    return(distance_from_grid)
}

min_x <- (mhq_terr_refpoints_update %>%
    filter(is_centroid) %>%
    filter(x == min(x)))$x

min_y <- (mhq_terr_refpoints_update %>%
    filter(is_centroid) %>%
    filter(y == min(y)))$y

check_refpoint <- mhq_terr_refpoints_update %>%
    group_by(point_code) %>%
    mutate(distance_centroid = distance_from_centroidgrid(min_x = min_x,
                              min_y = min_y,
                              measured_x = x,
                              measured_y = y) %>%
               round(2)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(is_centroid_check = distance_centroid < 1)

check_refpoint <- check_refpoint %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 31370, remove = FALSE)

check_refpoint <- check_refpoint %>%
    mutate(grts_check = (terra::extract(grts_master,check_refpoint))$GRTSmaster_habitats) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(in_c2 = point_code %in% mhq_terr_sample$point_code) %>%
    left_join(mhq_terr_assessments %>%
                  select(point_code, assessment_date, type, is_present, change_location),
              by = "point_code") %>%
    mutate(is_centroid_error = is_centroid != is_centroid_check,
           grts_error = grts_ranking != grts_check) %>%
    filter(grts_error | is_centroid_error)

```

Several errors occur.
We can distinguish different cases.

+ Case 1: 
    + the reference point is between 1 m and 1.5 m from the grid center and is_centroid is wrongly considered as TRUE
    + the deviation from the grid center is more likely a measurement error than an intended relocation
    + therefore we do not change the point_code (as we do with relocations), we just change is_centroid to FALSE

```{r}
# case 10840262_1 

case_1 <- check_refpoint %>%
    filter(is_centroid & is_centroid_error & distance_centroid < 1.5)

case_1 %>%
    select(point_code, grts_ranking, distance_centroid, is_centroid, is_centroid_check, grts_check, assessment_date, change_location) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE)

```

```{r}
case_1_corrected <- case_1 %>%
    mutate(is_centroid = FALSE) %>%
    select(point_code, is_centroid, grts_ranking, x, y) 

check_refpoint_remaining <- check_refpoint %>%
    anti_join(case_1_corrected, by = "point_code")
```

```{r}

give_xy_ranking <- function(ranking, grts_master = grts_master) {
    
    point <- ifel(grts_master %in% ranking, grts_master, NA) %>%
          as.points(values = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
          st_as_sf()
    
    result <- st_coordinates(point)
    
    return(result)
}

calc_distance_to_origin <- function(ranking, p_code, reference_points = mhq_terr_refpoints, grts = grts_master) {
    
    coords_origin <- give_xy_ranking(ranking = ranking, grts_master = grts)
    
    point <- mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
        filter(point_code %in% p_code) %>%
        mutate(distance_to_origin = sqrt((x - coords_origin[, "X"]) ^ 2 + (y - coords_origin[, "Y"]) ^ 2))
    
    return(point)
    
}
```

```{r}


give_ranking_xy <- function(x, y, grts_master = grts_master, crs = 31370) {
    
    point <- data.frame(x = x,
                        y = y) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = crs)
    
    ranking <- (terra::extract(grts_master, point))$GRTSmaster_habitats
    
}

give_ranking_coords <- function(data, coords, grts_master = grts_master, crs = 31370) {
    
    points <- data %>%
        st_as_sf(coords = coords, crs = crs, remove = FALSE)
    
    points <- points %>%
        mutate(grts_ranking = (terra::extract(grts_master, points))$GRTSmaster_habitats) %>%
        st_drop_geometry()
    
    return(points)
}


```

## Assessments

terr_assessments contains the assessment for the monitoring habitat quality programme

+ assessment_date: date of the assessment
    + If the target type was not observed, the assessment year was not recorded. In this case we take the median of the
    years in which the assessments took place.
+ point_code: the id of the point_code
+ type: the evaluated type
+ is_present:
    + TRUE if the evaluated type was observed
    + FALSE if the evaluated type was not observed
    + NA if no assessment could be performed (inaccessible) or if the type’s presence is unknown
+ no_habitat:
    + TRUE if no habitat type was observed,  altough a regional import biotope (rib) type might be present (the presence of rib types was not evaluated)
    + FALSE when any type is present,
    + NA when the evaluated type is absent or unknown and it is not known if any other type is present (in case the point is inaccessible)
+ assessment_source: field assessment or orthophoto
+ inaccessible: long term or short term
+ not_measurable: long term or short term
+ change_location: has the population unit been replaced

```{r}
types <- read_types()

#unique(refpoints_assessed_all$type_observed)

terr_assessments_new <- refpoints_assessed_all %>%
    mutate(is_present = ifelse(!is.na(type_observed), type_observed %in% types$type,
                               ifelse(!is.na(inaccessible) | !is.na(not_measurable), NA, 
                                      FALSE)
                              ),
           no_habitat = ifelse(type_observed %in% c("gh"), TRUE, 
                               ifelse(type_observed %in% types$type, FALSE, NA)),
           type = ifelse(is_present & !is.na(is_present), type_observed, type_target_all),
           change_location = relocation
           ) %>%
    select(assessment_date, point_code, type, is_present, no_habitat, assessment_source, inaccessible, not_measurable, change_location) %>%
    separate_rows(type, sep = ";") %>%
    mutate(type = factor(str_trim(type), levels = levels(types$type))) %>%
    arrange(assessment_date)

check_unique <- terr_assessments_new %>%
    group_by(assessment_date, point_code, type) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup()

check_status <- terr_assessments_new %>%
    filter(is.na(is_present) & (is.na(inaccessible) & is.na(not_measurable)))

check_refpoint <- terr_assessments_new %>%
    anti_join(mhq_terr_refpoints_update, by = "point_code")

check_new <- mhq_terr_assessments %>%
    inner_join(terr_assessments_new, by = c("point_code", "assessment_date"))

mhq_terr_assessments_update <- mhq_terr_assessments %>%
    bind_rows(terr_assessments_new) %>%
    arrange(assessment_date) %>%
    select(-db_ref)

check_unique <- mhq_terr_assessments_update %>%
    group_by(assessment_date, point_code, type) %>%

check_status <- mhq_terr_assessments_update %>%
```

## Measurements

mhq_terr_measurements: table with information on measurements

+ measurement_date
+ point_code
+ user_reference: reference to record in INBOVEG database
+ recording_givid
+ type: the observed type

```{r}
terr_measurements_new <- refpoints_assessed_all %>%
    filter(lsvi_measurement) %>%
    select(fieldwork_team, point_code, type = type_observed, measurement_date = assessment_date, db_ref, survey, user_reference, recording_givid) %>%
    mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c(levels(types$type), "gdh", "gh", "onbekend"))) %>%
    arrange(measurement_date)

check <- terr_measurements_new %>%
    group_by(point_code, measurement_date) %>%
    filter(n() > 1)

check_new <- mhq_terr_measurements %>%
    semi_join(terr_measurements_new, by = c("point_code", "measurement_date"))

mhq_terr_measurements_update <- mhq_terr_measurements %>%
    mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c(levels(types$type), "gdh", "gh", "onbekend"))) %>%
    bind_rows(terr_measurements_new) %>%
    select(fieldwork_team, point_code, type, measurement_date, db_ref, user_reference, recording_givid)
```
